SELECT t1.id, t1.brand, t1.prod_name, t1.spec, t1.price, t1.unit_price, t1.production_id, t1.our_price, t1.our_unit_price, t1.dept_id, t2.name prodution_name, t4.name sale_class_name, t1.create_time, dept.name FROM sale_compete_info t1 /** 竞品的信息 */ left join sale_production_info t2 /**产品信息*/ on t1.production_id = t2.id and t2.deleted=0 left join sale_production_marsaleclass t4 /**销售分类*/ on t4.id = t2.marsaleclass_id and t4.deleted=0 left join system_dept dept on dept.id = t1.dept_id and dept.deleted=0 where t1.deleted = 0
and t1.prod_name like concat('%',#{req.prodName},'%')
and t1.brand like concat('%',#{req.brand},'%')
and t1.spec = #{req.spec}

SELECT t1.id, t1.brand, t1.prod_name, t1.spec, t1.compete_id, t1.price, t3.name prodution_name, t4.name sale_class_name, t2.dept_id, t1.create_time FROM sale_compete_info t1 /** 竞品的信息 */ left join sale_production_compete_info t2 /**工厂设置的竞品*/ on t1.compete_id = t2.id and t2.deleted=0 left join sale_production_info t3 /**物料基本信息*/ on t3.id = t2.production_id and t3.deleted=0 left join sale_production_marsaleclass t4 /**销售分类*/ on t4.id = t3.marsaleclass_id and t4.deleted=0 where t1.deleted = 0
and t1.id = #{id}
